description: Return the live futures price of one contract month for gold (XAU), silver (XAG), copper (HG), platinum (XPT) or palladium (XPD). Without month it returns the most traded month; month is YYYY-MM. exchange=SHFE returns Shanghai gold futures in yuan per gram. Every answer names the contract month and carries price, bid, ask, day high and low, timestamp and delayed (true when the live feed is down). Free and keyless callers get prices 15 minutes late. When the market is closed it returns the last price with state closed.
name: get_futures_price
title: Get Futures Price
